modules.module_title: Prepare for industrial pipe fitting activities

pcs.pc_description: evaluate the project requirements, including the type of fluid, pressure, temperature, and environmental conditions
study the basic drawings and schematics of the piping system, to determine the pipe routes, materials, and dimensions
conduct a thorough inspection of the site to identify potential obstacles and ensure the environment is suitable for installation
use appropriate materials based on the project requirements, such as steel, copper, PVC, etc.
measure and cut pipes to the required lengths using tools like pipe cutters, saws, or torches.
assemble sections of the piping system in a controlled environment before transporting them to the installation site.
position the pipes correctly according to the schematics, ensuring proper alignment to prevent leaks and ensure smooth fluid flow
join pipes using appropriate joining methods, such as welding, threading, and flanging, depending on the type of pipe and the specific application.
install supports and anchors to secure the pipes and prevent movement due to pressure or thermal expansion

modules.module_title: Inspect, test and commission the piping system

pcs.pc_description: check the piping system visually for any obvious defects, misalignments, or improper joints.
perform pressure tests to ensure the system can handle the designated pressure without leaking.
carry out Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) following appropriate methods, such as Xrays and ultrasonic testing to inspect welds and joints for internal defects
carry out appropriate repair and maintenance of the piping system based on test results.
clean the piping system to remove debris, contaminants, and residues from the installation process.
conduct final checks to ensure all components are installed correctly and functioning as intended.
test the system under normal operating conditions to verify performance and ensure there are no leaks or other issues.
maintain the appropriate records concerning installation, inspections, and tests in compliance with industry standards and regulations

modules.module_title: Prepare for municipal pipe fitting activities

pcs.pc_description: determine the project requirements, including the type of fluid (e.g. water and sewage), pressure, and volume
conduct a survey and create maps of the target area for the installation of pipes
ensure the site environment is suitable for pipe fitting
study the detailed plans and schematics for the piping system, specifying pipe routes, materials, and dimensions
check for necessary permits and approvals for pipe fitting from local authorities and regulatory bodies
identify potential obstacles at the installation site and take appropriate preventive measures
check for the availability of the necessary materials, such as pipes, fittings, and valves, pipe fitting operations
coordinate the excavation of trenches along the planned pipe routes, ensuring they are deep and wide enough to accommodate the pipes and any necessary bedding materials
backfill the trenches with soil, compacting it in layers to ensure stability
lay pipes in the excavated trenches according to the design plans, ensuring proper alignment and slope to facilitate fluid flow
join pipes using appropriate methods, such as welding, threading, flanging, or using mechanical couplings and fittings
ensure all joints are secure and leak-proof
place appropriate bedding material, such as sand and gravel around the pipes to provide support and prevent damage

modules.module_title: Inspect and test the municipal piping system

pcs.pc_description: conduct a visual inspection of the entire system to check for any obvious defects or misalignments
perform hydrostatic testing or pneumatic testing to ensure the system can handle the designated pressure without leaking
identify potential leaks in the system using the relevant techniques such as dye testing or electronic leak detection
implement appropriate measures to plug the identified leakages
flush the piping system to remove any debris, contaminants, or residues from the installation process
disinfect water supply systems to ensure they are free from harmful bacteria and pathogens
conduct final checks under normal operating conditions to ensure all components are installed correctly and functioning as intended without leakages or other issues
schedule regular inspections to identify potential issues early and ensure the system continues to operate efficiently
implement appropriate plans for responding to emergencies, such as pipe bursts or leaks, to minimize disruptions to services
maintain appropriate records concerning pipe installation, inspections, and tests
